name: Szalánta (Hungary)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szalánta (a blue shield with a tree, birds and a red mound, within a green wreath) below a yellow scroll inscribed SZALÁNTA 1240 1332 1804.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szalánta arms with wreath and scroll
